# `aitbc market gpu quote`

Request an operator-signed energy quote for a GPU rental.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market gpu quote [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-id` | text | — | yes | GPU registry ID |
| `--buyer-id` | text | — | yes | Buyer client ID (native rail: the funding wallet address 0x...) |
| `--duration-hours` | float | `1.0` | no | Rental duration in hours |
| `--gpu-count` | integer | `1` | no | Number of GPUs |
| `--max-ait` | float | — | no | Maximum AIT buyer cap |
| `--settlement` | choice | `native` | no | Settlement rail |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market gpu quote --gpu-id <gpu_id> --buyer-id <buyer_id>
```
